about.title: About KBM Roofing and Restoration
text: KBM are our kids' initials, a daily reminder that family is at the heart of everything we do. We are a family-owned roofing company in Houston. We believe in honesty, hard work, and treating every home like it’s our own. As a local roofing company, we bring expertise and quality to every project. Our 7-year workmanship warranty isn’t just a guarantee—it’s our promise. If you want a roofing company that values trust and expert craftsmanship, give us a call. We’d love to help.
We assess your roof to determine whether you need a repair, replacement, or new installation.
Our experienced team installs your roof efficiently, following industry best practices and local codes.
